mentions.name: iOS NAS Media Streaming App
mentions.description: This iOS app streams the user's own music and videos directly from a NAS without a full media server like Plex or Jellyfin and without syncing files locally. Files stream over a VPN (WireGuard/Tailscale), mainly via SFTP/FTP, and play as-is without re-encoding or server-side indexing. Users can browse folders directly or build a lightweight local index for faster artist/album browsing on larger libraries, and a TestFlight beta is available.
mentions.problem: The author wanted access to their music and videos on their phone without running a full media server like Plex or Jellyfin and without syncing files locally.
mentions.audience: Wants access to personal music and videos on a phone without running a full media server like Plex or Jellyfin and without syncing files locally.
